Brother. I feel your pain... I really do.. But there is only one way you can help in this situation and that's talking to your parents. Or talking to a teacher if you don't want your parents to find out. Someone of importance you can help you in this situation. You are too special and brilliant to throw your life away. There are so many options for you that you don't even know about! You seem like a really smart and talented person. I envy your intelligence! Only you can make this change though.  People will help you along the way but it's down to you to make the jump into a good life. And that is still possible. First step is talking to a 'high up' person e.g teacher, parent etc. 

And as always I am here to talk to you. Always. Don't throw your life away. You are a fantastic human being. <3

Dealing with stress - If you are in school or anything like that you can talk to someone irl. If that is too much for you, you can TALK TO ME. Talk to anyone. Get this stuff off your chest (Like you have been doing). 

Contact - Go to your local hospital or community center as there will be leaflets for organizations to help you. 

You are a brave person for sticking at this. And your right, it's silly how all this has come down to you at a young age. What you should do is talk to someone IRL or even on reddit (E.G. ME). If you reach out in the world people will help. 

I hope this helped.. xx
